status: implemented and cross-compiled; SM120 regressions pass; physical SM103 execution unqualified

implementation.storage: Existing owning device, mapped-host and Grace placement remains intact. Disk tables optionally retain original E8M0 scale bytes in owned mapped host memory.
implementation.prefetch: One read per table retains the transaction, ID owner, preparing host thread and CUDA stream until consumption or abort. Error paths drain I/O before reusing staging.
implementation.execution: Hash metadata and packed gather remain supporting Triton kernels. Downstream model projections use the existing CuTe paths. Disk I/O prepares fixed output buffers before graph replay.
implementation.addressing: Global and local row-to-byte products use Int64, including separate resident-scale addressing.

compile.coverage: Hash validation, request mapping, reset and lookup. Lookup includes both primary layer geometries, both TP2 ranks, resident tables, staged tables and staged weights with resident scales.

validation.sanitizer: 13.4.57; kernel memcheck enabled; CUDA API-error reporting disabled explicitly
validation.coverage: Raw E8M0 boundaries, row-varying scales, duplicate rows, TP shard tails, high row offsets, frozen kernel resolution, graph mutation, cancellation and injected read/submission failure.

limitations: No SM103 execution or Grace bandwidth result.
These additions have not yet been exercised on SM121.
The isolated V4.1 companion port and full-model evaluation remain separate qualification work.
